name: TrussCraft
intro: Ama-truss ophahleni lokhuni kusuka ophahleni olusemodelini: ama-truss ajwayelekile, amasethi ehiphu (ama-truss ancishekayo, noma i-girder ephethe ama-jack kanye nama-truss amakhoneni), amasethi omfudlana phezu kophahla oluyinhloko, uhlu lwezitho, ukusika nokuhlanganiswa, imithwalo nokuhlanganiswa oyifakayo, nokuhlolwa kokuqala kwesitho. Isisiza ekuklameni, hhayi ukuklama.
